abilities.d: - This unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] - This unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
This unit’s attacks that target a Character unit can: - Re-roll hit rolls of 1 - Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
This model can be attached to the following units: ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD, BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, COMPANY HEROES, INTERCESSOR SQUAD, STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD, VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD

coreAb.d: This ability always takes the form [ANTI-X Y+]. Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI] weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by X, an unmodified wound roll of Y+ is a critical wound. *Example: An attack made with an [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] weapon against a Vehicle unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 4+, while an attack made with an [ANTI-PSYKER 2+] weapon against a Psyker unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 2+.*

facAb.d: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Combat Doctrine listed below. If you do, that Combat Doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command Phase Assault Doctrine When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. Devastator Doctrine This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] Tactical Doctrine When this unit is selected to make a Fall-back move, that Fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge. Unless otherwise stated. - You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle - Only one Combat Doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule make a Combat Doctrine active for a unit, any Combat Doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1 CP

abilities.d: - This unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault]. - When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. - If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
This model can be attached to the following units: OUTRIDER SQUAD

This ability always takes the form [SUSTAINED HITS X]. Each time an attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by X. *Example: An attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS 2] weapon results in a critical hit. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the critical hit, and twice more from the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability).*
